name: scema-web
description: Scematica Omni browser extension (MV3). No build step, no dependencies, no bundler.
//test: A quoted glob, not a bare directory. `node --test test/` resolves `test` as a module path on Windows and fails with MODULE_NOT_FOUND, which reads like a broken test file rather than a bad invocation.
//live: The wire tests skip unless SCEMA_OMNID_URL and SCEMA_OMNID_TOKEN are set, so `npm test` stays hermetic and offline.
